info.title: Atlas local API
info.description: Development contract revision 2. Canonical mutation snapshots are read before transaction commit; later reads can advance. Creation replay returns the original creation receipt, not current resource state. Empty strings clear optional string fields; nulls and unknown/duplicate fields are rejected. JSON object bodies are limited to 65536 bytes. Intended for local single-user use.

get.description: Literal case-insensitive text search in canonical records, newest update first. Task status: open/completed; reminder status: scheduled/due/dismissed/completed; notes require empty status. Unknown, duplicate, or malformed parameters return invalid_search. Pages may shift between requests when records change.

post.description: Validate explicit capture fields: default task, standalone reminder, or standalone note. Optional note_body links to all new action records. Preview never saves. Confirm unchanged preview.input with a required Idempotency-Key. preview_id identifies normalized content, not authorization. Capture returns TaskAction shape: task may be null, task_id empty, arrays contain captured records.

409.description: Changed/missing preview or conflicting retry key

503.description: Interrupted request or busy storage; retry unchanged

Confirm unchanged preview.input with a required Idempotency-Key. preview_id identifies normalized content, not authorization. Capture returns TaskAction shape: task may be null, task_id empty, arrays contain captured records. A fresh dependency commit rechecks referenced task version and open status; capture_context_changed requires preview again. Receipt replay precedes context checks.

post.description: Local English rule interpreter. Uses server reference time; never persists. Ready results include a validated capture proposal; unresolved wording returns questions and null proposal. Clients must display the proposal and obtain confirmation before commit. One task or standalone reminder or standalone note, with optional linked note and task reminder. Explicit before/ahead-of references resolve open task titles; ambiguous matches require selection. Context is visible user input. Ordering does not infer a delivery time. Reminder actions also suggest related open tasks by topic overlap and a small explicit vocabulary bridge. Matching context creates a prerequisite task with its linked reminder. Dated context supplies a reviewed lead time (default one hour); explicit time overrides it. Undated context and past derived times require clarification. Minutes/hours/day/week offsets before tasks are supported; saved delivery times are fixed snapshots. Common English timing includes end of day/week/month, close of business, named morning/afternoon/evening/night defaults, half/quarter hours and couple intervals. Defaults are returned as assumptions; passed fixed named times return named_time_passed. See the Capture phrase guide and API.md for exact clocks.

400.description: invalid_interpretation or strict JSON validation error

get.description: All dependency edges with canonical existence, status, and satisfaction. Deleted endpoints retain title snapshots.

put.description: Idempotently attach prerequisite ordering; cycles and completed targets are rejected.

delete.description: Idempotently remove ordering. Returns source state, or target state when source was deleted.

get.description: Symmetric related_to associations; optional record filters must be supplied together. Deleted-record provenance remains visible.

put.description: Idempotently attach two distinct existing records. Reversed endpoint order addresses the same resource. Does not affect lifecycle.

delete.description: Idempotently remove association, including missing endpoints. Reversed endpoint order addresses the same resource. Does not affect lifecycle.

post.description: Persistent capture conversation. Replies retain original context. Explicit yes/confirm/save it confirms a ready proposal; cancel closes without record creation. State confirming can be retried to recover the same committed receipt. Stale versions return 409. Session history is saved before confirmation; records are only created on confirmation. Unknown replies preserve unresolved meaning.

409.description: Stale version, closed session, or unresolved clarification

500.description: Unexpected failure; resume the session before retrying

repeat_anchor.description: Original UTC instant defining the local repeat clock. Empty for one-time reminders.

occurrence_id.description: Current queued or delivered occurrence ID; use in acknowledgement URL.

repeat.description: Daily or weekly in the supplied IANA timezone.

target_title.description: Current target title, or the snapshot captured when linked if deleted.

body.description: Non-whitespace plain text; preserved as supplied.
Non-whitespace plain text; preserved as supplied.

task_id.description: Existing open task ID, or empty to detach. Completed reminders cannot change links.

before_task_id.description: Optional existing open task that this new task must precede.

before_task_version.description: Snapshot fingerprint supplied by preview; return unchanged on commit.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for calendar and clock interpretation

context_task_id.description: Optional explicit context selection, used only for a matching before/ahead-of reference.

reminder_lead_minutes.description: Visible lead time when a reminder has dated task context but no explicit time. 0 means default 60. 1440 uses one local calendar day.

draft.description: Partial capture fields; not valid for commit until revalidated. May lack required times or title.

event.description: Interim interpreter recognized an event statement. Its time sets task due_at and, absent an explicit reminder clause, a linked reminder.

request.description: Internal envelope: version, request_id, text, timezone, reference_at, answers, bounded context, mock_scenario and mock_context_query.

response.description: Untrusted or empty provider output, retained for diagnostics; may violate the provider contract.

text.description: Maximum 12000 UTF-8 bytes; stricter than character count for non-ASCII input.

cost_usd.description: Originating evaluation cost, not an additional charge on cache hits.
